title: Load Balancing Modes
summary: The mode list shown by Set Balancing Mode. Each Apply probes the selected nodes and uses the mode to pick the next active node.

items.title: Round-Robin (distribute equally)
items.description: Each Apply moves to the next reachable node in the list.
items.usage_tip: Good for spreading use evenly across similar nodes.

items.title: Least Ping (prefer lowest latency)
items.description: Picks the reachable node with the lowest measured TCP connect or ping time.

items.title: Failover (use next only if previous fails)
items.description: Keeps the first reachable node in list order; later nodes are used only when earlier ones fail.
items.usage_tip: Most predictable option for daily use.

items.title: Random
items.description: Picks a random node among the reachable ones.
items.usage_tip: Nodes that fail the probe are never chosen.
